title: Scott Andrews taken to space command as a child for alien communication
place_text: Air Force base with a space command center

tellings.quote: class and he was taken to, uh, space command to the an Air Force base with a space command center and was doing kind of intuitive communications with aliens.

plain: A man named Scott Andrews is said to have been taken as a child to an Air Force base with a space command centre, the part of the military that watches over space, to do "intuitive communications with aliens," meaning contact by mind rather than by machine. Michels passes this on from Andrews himself, in a conversation about a former Army sergeant named Dan Sherman who says a government spy agency hired him for similar work. If true, it would mean the military used gifted children as go-betweens with non-human beings.
